audit.whatIsWrong: The chart gave Renekton Level 1 and Singed Level 3. The packet chart says Singed at Level 1 and Skill at Level 3, and the already-audited mirror (singed__renekton) flipped its rows to match — leaving this side contradicting its own mirror.
audit.why: At Level 1 Singed either proxies or lays Poison Trail through the wave and Renekton cannot interact; by Level 3 Renekton's full pattern makes it a skill lane, not a Singed win. The page's own whys[0] already described a Singed Level 1 while the chart said Renekton.
audit.corrected: Level 1 flipped to Singed (3/10) and Level 3 to Skill (5/10) in both layers, proposed as one atomic group.

audit.why: Level 2, level 6 Dominus, Singed's Rylai's first item, and his late proxy game — four spikes, correctly ordered. Level 6 is genuinely the only reliable solo-kill window.
audit.corrected: whys[4] tightened to name the anti-heal deadline inside that window.

audit.whatIsWrong: Three problems. (1) Ability slots are swapped throughout: Poison Trail is Q (not E) and Fling is E (not W); Mega Adhesive is the W. (2) Mega Adhesive GROUNDS — inside it Slice and Dice cannot be cast at all, and a Fling that lands you in it also roots you. Grounding appears nowhere on the page. (3) Insanity Potion makes Poison Trail apply Grievous Wounds, halving Cull the Meek's heal — the flagged missing interaction.
audit.why: Grounding is the reason the escape half of your combo fails against Singed specifically, and the anti-heal is why the level-6 all-in has a deadline. Both were absent.
audit.corrected: Slots corrected in wants.foe[0] and wants.foe[1]; grounding written into phases[2].why, breakdown.cooldowns, dontsFull[1].d, report[5].t and wants.you[1]; Grievous Wounds written into whys[4] and breakdown.cooldowns.
sources: champ-data/_kits/singed.json (Q, W grounding flag + text, E text, R antiHeal text)

audit.whatIsWrong: No real numbers on the punishable cooldowns.
audit.why: Fling is 10s at rank 1, Mega Adhesive 17s, Insanity Potion a flat 100s — those decide when you can approach.
audit.corrected: Added to breakdown.cooldowns, dosFull[0].d and report[5].t.

edits.before: Fury autos bully the first waves. Identify how Singed contests the first waves before you commit anything.
edits.after: Singed proxies or trails poison through the wave — farm at Q range and take no trade that costs you ticks.

edits.before: Full kit online — your core pattern starts now. Keep the wave near your side so Singed must walk into your engage range.
edits.after: Full kit online, but Mega Adhesive grounds — inside the goo Slice and Dice will not cast, so never engage across it.

edits.before: - Singed Fling: matchup-defining — His flip. Bait it, then W-stun. Track it before every engage. - Your committal tool: never spend it on chip. - Your ultimate: the win condition — kill windows only.
edits.after: - Singed Fling: 10s at rank 1, and it throws you behind him into the trail. - Mega Adhesive: 17s, and it grounds — your E will not cast inside it. - Insanity Potion: 100s, its Grievous Wounds halves your Q heal.

edits.before: His flip. Bait it, then W-stun. Only engage once it is down or baited.
edits.after: Fling is 10s at rank 1 — bait it, then W-stun him on clear ground.

edits.before: Burning it for tiny value leaves you naked for its full cooldown.
edits.after: Flung into Mega Adhesive you are rooted, and grounding kills your E.

edits.before: Track Singed's Fling: His flip. Bait it, then W-stun. When it is down — W-stun + Q him.
edits.after: Mega Adhesive grounds: no Slice and Dice inside it. Fling is 10s — bait it, then burst.

edits.before: Dominus gives you the HP buffer to absorb four or five poison ticks mid-stun — pop R before you E in and kill him while the bonus health eats the damage.
edits.after: Dominus buffers the poison mid-stun — pop R before you E in, and go before Insanity Potion lands: its Grievous Wounds halves the Q heal you are relying on.

edits.before: Save your E exit dash so you are never committed inside his poison trail longer than the stun duration
edits.after: Never engage across Mega Adhesive — it grounds, so your E exit will not cast while you stand in it

edits.before: Lay his poison trail (E) between you and the wave so every CS you take deals chip damage over time
edits.after: Lay Poison Trail (Q) between you and the wave so every CS you take costs chip damage over time

edits.before: Fling (W) you behind him when you engage so you must run through even more poison trail to disengage
edits.after: Fling (E) you back into Mega Adhesive so you are rooted, grounded, and cannot dash out of the trail

notes: Ability slots were swapped across this page (Poison Trail called E, Fling called W) — corrected. Grounding from Mega Adhesive was missing entirely and is the single most important mechanic here, since it disables Slice and Dice outright rather than just slowing the escape. The mirror singed__renekton had already flipped Level 1 and Level 3; this side now matches instead of contradicting it. Noted from the mirror: _missing/singed.json claims Ruthless Predator gives Renekton a shield — Riot's text says it DESTROYS shields on the target, so that headline was not written here either.
